name: Unitika Ltd.
blurb: Unitika Ltd. is a Japanese chemical and textile company that manufactures and sells spunbond non-woven fabrics, films, resins, and other industrial materials. The company operates globally, with a focus on functional materials and environmental solutions. As part of a business revitalization plan announced in November 2024, Unitika has been restructuring its operations, including the dissolution of its Thai subsidiary THAI UNITIKA SPUNBOND CO., LTD.
recent: On April 27, 2026, Unitika announced the dissolution of its consolidated subsidiary THAI UNITIKA SPUNBOND CO., LTD. (TUSCO) as part of its ongoing business revitalization plan. The subsidiary's business was transferred on January 30, 2026, and liquidation procedures are underway. The company expects a minor impact on consolidated earnings.
